            root: '/'
        });
        $(window).on('load', function () {
            $('#mobileAccountBtn').on('click', function () {
                var navToggle = $('.navbar-toggle');
                if (!navToggle.hasClass('collapsed')) {
                    navToggle.click();
                }
            });

            var isFaq = testFaq();

            function testFaq() {
                if ($('.tft-faq').length > 0) {
                    return true;
                } else {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            if (isFaq === true) {
                var storedName = $('#additionalNav li.active > a').text();
                $('.js-store-name').text(storedName);

                $('#additionalNav li > a').on('click', function () {
                    storedName = $(this).text();
                    $('.js-store-name').text(storedName);
                });

                $('#additionalNav').on('shown.bs.collapse', $('.side-rail .btn-nav'), function (event) {

                    //$('.js-store-name').text(storedName);
                });

                $('#additionalNav').on('hide.bs.collapse', $('.side-rail .btn-nav'), function (event) {
                    $('.js-store-name').text(storedName);
                });

            } else {
                var storedName = $('.js-store-name').text();

                $('#additionalNav').on('show.bs.collapse', $('.side-rail .btn-nav'), function (event) {
                    $('.js-store-name').text('Close');
                });
                $('#additionalNav').on('hide.bs.collapse', $('.side-rail .btn-nav'), function (event) {
                    $('.js-store-name').text(storedName);
                });

            }
        });

        $(document).ready(function () {
            if ($('.ie9').length > 0 || $('.ltIE9').length > 0) {
                var inputs = $('input[type="text"]');

                inputs.each(function () {
                    var $this = $(this)
                    var thisPlaceholder = $this.attr('placeholder');

                    $this.before('<label class="ie-label">' + thisPlaceholder + '</label>');
                });

                var inputsemail = $('input[type="email"]');

                inputsemail.each(function () {
                    var $this = $(this)
                    var thisPlaceholder = $this.attr('placeholder');

                    $this.before('<label class="ie-label">' + thisPlaceholder + '</label>');
                });

                var inputspw = $('input[type="password"]');

                inputspw.each(function () {
                    var $this = $(this)
                    var thisPlaceholder = $this.attr('placeholder');

                    $this.before('<label class="ie-label">' + thisPlaceholder + '</label>');
                });

                var selects = $('select');

                selects.each(function () {
                    var $this = $(this)
                    var thisPlaceholder = $this.attr('placeholder');
                    if (thisPlaceholder != undefined)
                        $this.before('<label class="ie-label">' + thisPlaceholder + '</label>');
                });
            }

            var menuButton = $(".navbar-toggle");
            var perimeter = $(".perimeter");
            var windowWidth = $(window).width();

            menuButton.on("click", function () {
                if ($(".black-overlay").length > 0) {
                    $(".black-overlay").remove();
                } else {
                    perimeter.prepend("<div class='black-overlay'></div>");
                }
            });
            $(window).on("resize", function () {
                windowWidth = window.innerWidth; // IE9+

                if (windowWidth > 992) {
                    $('body').addClass('desktop');

                    if ($('body').hasClass('desktop') && $(".black-overlay").length > 0) {

                        $(".black-overlay").remove();

                    }
                } else {
                    $('body').removeClass('desktop');
                }
            });
        });</script><!--[if lte IE 6]><script type="text/javascript" src="/tft-js/core/jquery.ie6.js"></script><![endif]--><script>$(function () {

            ko.applyBindings(new tft.viewModels.SearchViewModel(), document.getElementById('topNav'));

            var classes = document.getElementsByTagName('html')[0].className.split(/\s+/);
            for (var i = 0; i < classes.length; i++) {
                if (classes[i].length >= 10 && classes[i].substr(0, 10) == 'top-level-') {
                    var data = classes[i].replace('top-level-', '');
                    var items = $('ul.nav li[data-nav*=' + data + ']');
                    if (items.length > 0) {
                        $(items[0]).addClass('active');
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
        });</script><!-- URL HTTS to HTTP --><script>$(function () {

            $("a").filter(':not(.skipprotocolswitch)').each(function () {
                if (location.protocol.indexOf('https') > -1) {
                    var href = $(this).attr('href');

                    if (typeof href !== 'undefined' && href !== false) {

                        if (href.indexOf('https') > -1 && href.indexOf('nccpa') > -1) {

                            var nonssl = href.replace('https', 'http');
                            $(this).attr('href', nonssl);

                        }
                        else if (href.indexOf('http') !== 0) {
                            var nonssl = '';
                            var char1 = href.substring(0, 1);
                            if (char1 == '#' || char1 == '~' || href.indexOf('javascript:') > -1 || href.indexOf('mailto') > -1 || href.indexOf('tel:') > -1) {
                                nonssl = href;
                            }
                            else if (char1 != '/')
                                nonssl = "http://" + location.host + '/' + href;
                            else
                                nonssl = "http://" + location.host + href;
                            $(this).attr('href', nonssl);
                        }
                    }
                }
            })

            $('map').imageMapResize();

        })
        function openModal(id) {
            $('#' + id).modal({
                keyboard: false
            })
        }</script><script>var TIMES_CHAT_POLLED = 0; //used in getLiveQueueStats.js
        //ensure webchatlocal.js is loaded after webchat.min.js is loaded
        // document.getElementById("webchatminjs").addEventListener("load", loadWebchatLocal);
        function loadWebchatLocal() {
            var script = document.createElement('script');
            script.src = "/WebChat/webchatLocal.js";
            script.defer = true;
            script.async = true;
            document.body.appendChild(script);

            window.localStorage.setItem('chatqueue', 4467);

            getWebChatAvailability();
        }

        var chatWindowReference = null;
        var chatWindowIntervalHandle = null;
        function openChatWindow() {
            if (location.pathname.indexOf('contact-us.aspx') > -1) {
                if (chatWindowReference == null || chatWindowReference.closed) {
                    //Win OS settings
                    var chatWindow_height = 432;
                    var chatWindow_width = 380;
                    var chatWindow_offsetTop = 50;
                    var chatWindow_offsetLeft = 0;
                    var top = 0;
                    var left = 0;
                    //for all other OSes, increase the window height
                    if (window.navigator.platform.indexOf('Win') === -1) {
                        chatWindow_height = 450;
                    }
                    top = window.innerHeight - chatWindow_height + chatWindow_offsetTop;
                    left = window.innerWidth - chatWindow_width + chatWindow_offsetLeft;

                    chatWindowReference = window.open("WebChat/WebChat.html", "_blank", "toolbar=no, location=no, status=no, menubar=no, titlebar=no, scrollbars=yes, resizable=no, alwaysRaised=yes, personalbar=no, dependent=yes, chrome=yes, width=" + chatWindow_width + ", height=" + chatWindow_height + ", left=" + left + ", top=" + top);

                    //poll for chat window closed
                    chatWindowIntervalHandle = setInterval(receiveWebChatClosedMessage, 1000);
                }
            }
        }

        //called when user closes chat window
        function receiveWebChatClosedMessage() {
            if (chatWindowReference != undefined && chatWindowReference != null) {
                if (chatWindowReference.closed) {
                    clearInterval(chatWindowIntervalHandle);
                    delete chatWindowReference;
                    getWebChatAvailability();
                }
            }
        }

        function getWebChatAvailability() {
            if ($("#chatTrigger").css('display') != 'none')
                $("#chatTrigger").hide();

            TIMES_CHAT_POLLED = 0;

            // checkWebChatAvailability();
        }

        //this element (which is on this page) is in the CMS database, so you won't find it in the visible HTML above
        $('#chatTrigger').on('click', function () {
            openChatWindow();
        });</script><script>$(document).ready(function () {
	        var $reports = $("#ctl00_EntireBody_EntireContent_uxReportsQV_editableContent"),
	            $dates = $("#ctl00_EntireBody_EntireContent_uxDatesQV_editableContent"),
	            mobileNewsItemsTabs = $('.news-items-mobile [role="tab"]'),
	            mobileTabContent = $('.tab-content .view-more');
            // Copy desktop over to mobile
            $("#reportsQVMobile").html($reports.html());
            $("#datesQVMobile").html($dates.html());
            $('.news-items .col-sm-4').each(function (index) {
	            var self = $(this),
	                childH3 = self.find('h3'),
	                childH3Text = childH3.clone().children().remove().end().text(),
	                selfTitleAnchorText = self.find('a:not([id]):first').text();
	            $(mobileNewsItemsTabs[index]).text(childH3Text);
	            $(mobileTabContent[index]).text(selfTitleAnchorText);
            });
        });</script></body></html>
